Name: Zora's Sam Portrait Mod
Author: ZoraIllustrates
Description:
These are my Sam portraits! It took a very long time, but I'm finally done and so happy to put this out!

This pack includes Sam's beach outfit, Winter outfit and Joja Mart outfit.

Also, since this is my second mod, do let me know if there are any errors or bugs. I'll do my best to fix them ASAP. 

The Portraiture mod is required for this mod to work.

[u]How to install?[/u]

1. Download Portraiture.
2. Drag and drop Portraiture into your mods folder.
3. Locate the "Portraits" folder in Portraiture.
4. Download and unzip my mod.
5. Copy and paste it into the folder. 
6. As soon as you are in-game, talk to Sam.
7. Press P to change the base game Portrait to this mod when the DialogBox is open.

*****If you've downloaded my previous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35470]Sebastian Mod[/url]﻿, please drop the Sam PNGs into that folder (and label it correctly so you don't lose Sam!). This will ensure that when you swap to my portraits, they're all in the same bucket.
